Name: Lost Underwear
Author: Untolddead
Description:
[b][u]The update eliminates the place holder objects. When installing the new version any underwear laying about from version 1.0 and 1.1 will show up as an error. Just pick it up and trash it. The underwear will spawn correctly after that.[/u]

No longer require Json Assets![/b]

You can't wear the underwear! There is no function for changing underwear in the game. To do it you'd have to create a new model of the farmer for each one. If you are interested feel free do this.

With that out of the way. This is an [b][u]early [/u][/b]some might say alpha version of the mod. There is unique underwear for each adult character they spawn in each characters room. Now have gender swapped items selectable in the mod config.
Currently Vanilla map only.

If you do not see underwear in their rooms an npc walked on it. I've tested the locations and they are mostly safe but every so often a few get destroyed. It will be there on the next day.

[b][size=3]Conflicts:[/size][/b]
I don't see any reason this will conflict with other mods.

[b][size=3]Help out!:
I must admit I'm not particularly interested in the male npcs. I will make boxers, white underwear, and tight boxers. If you want something sexy or something else you can create the art and send it to me or create a your own mod that overwrites my art.
[/size][/b]
I'm uploading this to get suggestions. This will have a pretty rapid upload through out February. I plan to add events and quests down the road.

At the moment I would like to hear what underwear you'd like to see and for which characters! Including expanded stardew. Thanks!

Downloads.Description: Switch underwear based on sex. All generic males have panty items and all generic female characters have underwear items. Now with the default sexes set correctly.
